native-passkey-picker.reason: The reference draws the browser or password manager credential picker. Deck invokes WebAuthn and does not draw native credential UI. This rectangle covers only that externally owned picker; the Deck waiting state remains compared.

device-chrome-top.reason: Device mock, not app chrome. The comp draws the screen inside a 393x852 phone frame with a 1px bezel and a 54px status strip. On device that strip is the OS's and the bezel does not exist, so the app renders none of it. The preview reserves the same geometry so the app's content lands at this reference's origin; this band is the reservation and is not ours to converge.

os-home-band.reason: Device mock, not app chrome. The comp reserves a 35px home-indicator band under the screen that belongs to the OS; the app never paints there.
